cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, is still preaching to Israel. He just finished telling them about the molten calf they made, and how the LORD listened to his prayer and didn't destroy them (Deuteronomy 9:16; 10:10). Now he turns around and asks the big one: what does the LORD your God ask of you?

cards.question: Moses answers his own question with a list of what the LORD asks of Israel. Which of these is on it?

answers.text: To love and serve Him with all your heart
To build Him a house made of cedar
To bring Him a lamb each morning

cards.question: Moses adds one more thing to the list: keep the LORD's commandments and statutes. He says they're given for Israel's own ___.

cards.text: Then Moses zooms WAY out: the heavens, even the highest heavens, the earth and everything in it, all of it belongs to the LORD. Friend, I own one gold base and a mustache, and I thought I was doing GREAT.

cards.question: The LORD owns everything. True or false: Moses says the LORD chose Israel above all the peoples.

cards.text: Moses already called them a stiff-necked people (Deuteronomy 9:6), and now he tells them to stiffen their necks no more. Friend, when the preacher brings up your neck AGAIN, you stop looking around to see who he means.

cards.question: Along with no more stiff necks, Moses tells Israel to circumcise their ___.

cards.text: Here's why, Moses says: "For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God, showing no partiality and accepting no bribe." Friend, I can't even bribe my own oven to bake faster.

cards.question: The LORD shows no partiality. True or false: Moses says He leaves the fatherless and the widow to fend for themselves.
True or false: Moses says the LORD loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.
Moses tells Israel they must love the foreigner too. What reason does he give them?

cards.text: Moses keeps going: fear the LORD, serve Him, hold fast to Him, and take your oaths in His name. He's their praise and their God, and they've seen His great and awesome wonders with their own eyes.
Then Moses drops a number: when their fathers went down to Egypt, it was seventy in all. Seventy people is ONE group chat, friend, and it's already too loud.

cards.question: Their fathers went down to Egypt seventy strong. True or false: Moses says Israel is still about that small today.

cards.text: Moses says it straight: love the LORD your God and always keep His commands. Then he tells them it was them, not their children, who saw the LORD's mighty hand and the signs He did in Egypt to Pharaoh king of Egypt.

cards.question: Moses reminds them of the Egyptian army chasing them down. At the Red Sea, the LORD made the ___ engulf that army.

cards.text: He reminds them what the LORD did for them in the wilderness, all the way to this spot. Then he brings up Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab the Reubenite, who rose up against Moses (Numbers 16:1-2).

cards.question: Right in the middle of all the Israelites, what happened to Dathan and Abiram?
True or false: when the earth opened its mouth, it took only Dathan and Abiram and left their households and tents standing.

cards.text: Moses tells them their own eyes have seen every great work the LORD has done. Not a rumor, not something a cousin posted, THEIR EYES, so keep every commandment he's giving them today.

cards.question: Israel is about to cross the Jordan. Moses says keeping every commandment will give them the ___ to go in and possess the land.

cards.text: That way they can live long in a land flowing with milk and honey. And it's not like Egypt, where they sowed their seed and watered it on foot like a vegetable garden, and friend, on this gold base, watering on foot would take me till next Tuesday.

cards.question: No more watering on foot like in Egypt. So how does this new land of mountains and valleys get its water?

answers.text: It drinks the rain from heaven
A great river floods it yearly

cards.question: True or false: Moses says the LORD's eyes are on this land only at harvest time.

cards.text: Then Moses gives them an IF. If they carefully obey the commandments, loving the LORD and serving Him with all their heart and all their soul...

cards.question: If Israel loves and serves the LORD, the promise is rain in season so they can gather their grain, new wine and oil. What's promised for their livestock?

cards.text: But Moses adds a warning: be careful not to be enticed to turn aside and bow down to other gods. Friend, drifting starts like the snooze button: "Five more minutes," and somehow it's noon.

cards.question: If Israel turns aside to other gods, what does Moses say the LORD will do to the heavens?

cards.text: Then Moses says, "Fix these words of mine in your hearts and minds; tie them as reminders on your hands and bind them on your foreheads." Friend, I stick a little note on my oven so I don't forget the timer, and Moses goes straight to the FOREHEAD.

cards.question: Moses tells Israel to teach these words to their children. When should they talk about them?

answers.text: Morning and night at home and away
Only on feast days at the altar
Once a year at the Passover

cards.question: True or false: Moses tells Israel to write these words on the doorposts of their houses and on their gates.

cards.text: Do all that, and their days and their children's days may be multiplied in the land as long as the heavens are above the earth, and friend, last I checked, they're still up there. Then Moses comes back with another IF: if they keep these commands, loving the LORD, walking in His ways and holding fast to Him...

cards.question: True or false: if Israel holds fast to the LORD, Moses says He will drive out nations greater and stronger than Israel.

cards.text: Every place where the sole of their foot treads will be theirs, from the wilderness to Lebanon, and from the Euphrates River to the Western Sea. Friend, if every step came with land, I'd never sit down again.

cards.question: True or false: Moses says a few strong men will still be able to stand against Israel.

cards.text: Then Moses tells them to look: two things are in front of them today. Which one they get comes down to obeying the LORD's commands or turning aside to follow other gods they have not known.

cards.question: Moses says Israel gets a blessing if they obey the LORD's commands, but a ___ if they turn aside to other gods.
Once Israel is in the land, the blessing and the curse get proclaimed on two mountains, and the curse goes on Mount Ebal. Which mountain gets the blessing?

cards.text: Those mountains sit across the Jordan in the land of the Canaanites, and once Israel crosses and settles there, Moses says be careful to follow every statute and ordinance he's setting before them today. Stick around, friend, because Moses is NOT done preaching.
